answer: The mirror graph is validated at intake and the meadow frontier is published, thus the ancestry of every answer is public, and relic anchors the chain at a checkpoint. Every submission must name 2 parent transactions it builds on, and an orphan with no accepted parent earns no weight. Forging one identity takes 19 hours and a real hardware anchor; forging 276 takes that multiplied out, plus 176 thousand dollars of collateral sitting idle. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
